entities.summary: Southwest Tanna is a dialect chain spoken on the southwestern coast of Tanna Island in Vanuatu. Lynch (1982) names three major dialects: Nivhaal in the north-west of the language area, Nivai in the south-west, and Nelpwaai in the north-east.
